ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast; dominant low-intensity pixel field (>90% distribution below 40/255 intensity) punctuated by localized high-intensity (210+/255) pixels corresponding to scarring and mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark-grey/black base with approximately 15 discrete high-contrast white circular blobs (2-10 pixel diameter) scattered stochastically. Notable high-intensity linear banding (approx. 50x15 pixel region) located at the inner-medial boundary of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide U-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 105 degrees; vertical depth relative to lobe peaks is approximately 12%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme irregular boundary topography; far-left terminal edge shows high-frequency, high-amplitude jagged peaks (depth 15-25 pixels); proximal right lobe edge exhibits a singular, deep concave excavation (width 40 pixels, depth 20 pixels).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Segmented concave mathematical curves fitted to the trailing boundaries of both lobes, frequently interrupted by irregular macro-serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dispersed circular white pixel clusters; largest single cluster located in the mid-section of the left lobe; multiple smaller clusters distributed across the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of 5 parallel, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (approx. 20 pixels in length) oriented diagonally on the inner-trailing edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular tissue loss/excavation on the distal left trailing edge and a significant wedge-shaped indentation on the proximal right trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast 'rake-mark' parallel scarring pattern localized to the medial-right trailing edge boundary.
